thought.title: Tune BlockM 128→64 for Load Balancing
thought.description: Changed DEFAULT_BLOCK_M from 128 to 64 for better load balancing across 32 cores. For M=4096: blocks increase from 32 to 64, tasksPerCore from 1 to 2. For small M (e.g., M=1024): 16 cores used vs 8, doubling core utilization.
thought.reason: With blockM=128 and small M (1024), only ceil(1024/128)=8 blocks → 8 cores used out of 32. With blockM=64: ceil(1024/64)=16 blocks → 16 cores used. Doubles parallelism for small batches without hurting large batches.
thought.target_bottleneck: Load balancing for small M batches
